intro.text:
The tunnel from the ossuary slopes downward into unexpected warmth. Torchlight flickers ahead. Voices echo through the stone: haggling, laughter, whispered threats.

Then the passage opens into a cavern lit by corpse-candles and hanging lanterns.

Stalls crowd the cavern floor. One merchant sells wedding rings cut from dead fingers. Another displays swords still wet with old battlefield memories. A masked auctioneer presents a saint's jawbone on a velvet cushion.

This is the Grave-Market.

Here, the dead are inventory.

Orren Vale pulls his hood low.

"Oh no," he says. "Won't they feel our presence?"

As if he prompted it, you feel the undead eyes on you.

Above the central auction block hangs a sign painted in red:
No refunds. No resurrections. No questions.

outro.text:
You see the last shimmer of the necromancy that keeps him alive. He stares at you.

"You are too late. The Crown is gone. She, the one who mourns, already bought it. Prepare for all your lives to end."

Orren whispers: "Lady Mourne? Lady Yseld Mourne? I know her. We also wanted to sell to her. She controls the Silent Cathedral."

The market bells begin to ring.

You feel your blood freeze.

A figure in a rotted tabard steps onto the auction block: a ghostly herald with ash falling from his mouth.

"Hear now the decree of His Buried Majesty," the herald calls. "The crown returns. The oaths awaken. The traitor-blood shall kneel or be cut from the world."

The Ashen Herald turns its empty gaze toward you.

"You are summoned to witness judgment. I wish you luck."

storyTriggers.title: The Grave-Market
storyTriggers.text: The cavern opens around you in tiers of rotten commerce. Every stall turns at once. Every dead merchant pauses just long enough to decide what you might be worth.

storyTriggers.title: The Counting House
storyTriggers.text: Ledgers are chained to the desks here. Names have been scraped out and written again in grave-wax. Somewhere in these records is the buyer who took the Crown.

storyTriggers.title: No Questions
storyTriggers.text: The auction block waits under red paint and corpse-candle smoke. The Masked Auctioneer raises one hand, and the last bidding bell begins to ring.
